title: engineer-support-briefing-cedric-lam-apr04-2026
body:
Goal: focused, practical 1:1 with Cedric. Mix of short-term unblock + career signals. Keep it <30 min.

Agenda (20-30m):
- Quick check-in (2m): mood, calendar pain, anything urgent
- Blockers deep-dive (8-10m): infra onboarding, current RDW tickets, test flakes
- Career / growth checkpoint (6-8m): ownership next steps, visibility, stretch goal
- Action items + follow-ups (4-6m): owners, due dates, quick wins

Pre-meeting checklist (things I will bring):
- Open the RDW-2345 jira and call out the acceptance criteria we agreed on last sprint.
- PRs to skim: serving-runtime PR #789 (perf regressions?), infra-ops PR #812 (deploy script).
- Failure rates: staging e2e flake rate (last 7d) from dashboard — bring numbers.
- Recent support tickets assigned to Cedric (IDs in linked_artifacts).

Key talking points / prompts (notes to self):
- Onboarding: how comfortable are you with the KV cache code paths? Which parts still feel fuzzy?
- Ask for concrete examples of where docs or small pairing would have helped last week.
- Blockers: list the single critical blocker and what temporary workaround you'd accept.
- Perf/regression: if PR #789 caused a latency blip, confirm reproduction steps and whether you want rollback or hotfix prioritization.
- Tests: isolate flaky tests — is this infra timing or test harness? Propose a 1-hour pairing to debug.
- Career: two-sprint plan for expanding ownership to cross-service rollouts. Identify one tiny project you can lead (owner: Cedric).

Open questions I want answers to in the meeting:
- Which of the KV cache subtasks do you think we can defer without product impact? (list the subtask ids in meeting)
- Do you prefer pairing for root-cause or do you want me to assign a SRE buddy?
- What help would make your PR review turnaround under 24h?

Signals to watch (if raised, escalate):
- Repeated test flakes across multiple jobs -> allocate time to flip to more deterministic harness.
- Cedric expresses burnout / capacity gap -> pause non-critical work and reallocate.
- Unclear handoff from infra team -> schedule short sync with infra owners.

Notes about tone and coaching approach:
- Keep direct and pragmatic. Use micro-commitments (e.g., "can you own hotfix by EOD Wednesday?").
- Praise specificity: when Cedric points to a root cause, call it out and note that visibility.
- If career talk tilts toward promotion, capture examples and start small evidence collection (PRs, ownership).

Draft phrasing for career prompt:
- "Where do you want to be most visible in the next two sprints? Which users / teams would you want to be known for helping?"
- "One measurable stretch: lead the canary rollout for the KV cache feature and own the post-rollout health report. Would you take that?"

Action items (write these live during meeting) - template I will use:
- Action: "Pair-debug failing test (staging e2e)" | Owner: Cedric | Due: 2026-04-07 | Notes: I will join for first 60 min; add ticket RDW-2411.
- Action: "Patch and revert PR #789 if perf regression confirmed" | Owner: Alex Rivers / Cedric | Due: 2026-04-05 | Notes: If revert, submit hotfix PR and notify #serving-runtime.
- Action: "Create small onboarding doc for KV cache internals" | Owner: Cedric | Due: 2026-04-13 | Notes: 1 page summary + diagram; link from Confluence page.
- Action: "Identify single cross-service rollout to lead" | Owner: Cedric | Due: 2026-04-20 | Notes: pick scoped rollout (canary + rollback plan).
- Action: "Set up weekly 30m triage slot for infra handoff" | Owner: Alex Rivers | Due: 2026-04-09 | Notes: invite infra owners and SRE buddy.

Follow-up template (for adding to calendar / slack):
- Post-meeting note to #serving-runtime: short status + action owners (copy-paste).
- Add tickets for each action and link here.
- Set reminders 48h before due dates.

Quick metrics to pull now (I will paste into chat at top of meeting):
- Staging e2e flake rate (7d): 11% -> target <4%
- PR review turnaround for Cedric (last 14d): median 36h -> target 24h
- Deploy success rate for infra-ops deploys (7d): 98.2% -> target 99.5%

Possible escalation paths (if needed):
- If rollback + hotfix required and we miss EOD: escalate to SRE lead (Maya) and page on-call.
- If capacity problem: ask Eng Manager Org for 0.2 FTE support for two sprints (submit request).

Meeting script (very short):
1) "How's your week? Anything blocking you?" (listen, 30s)
2) "Let's look at the failing test — what's the smallest repro?" (3-4m)
3) "If we need a rollback, can you own the hotfix?" (explicit yes/no)
4) Career prompt + offer to help gather evidence for promotion if that is the direction.
5) Summarize actions and confirm due days.

Post-meeting: immediate messages (I will send):
- To Cedric: copy of actions + calendar invites for pairing + triage.
- To #serving-runtime: one-line status + if rollback/hotfix triggered.
- Create RDW-2411 for pairing debug, tag Cedric + Alex.

Loose notes / scratch ideas for future 1:1s:
- Consider 3-month rotation in infra-oncall to broaden system ownership.
- Small visibility tasks: write a short postmortem or "what I learned" doc after the next rollout.
- Map a clear list of 3 deliverables that would support a Level 3->4 case (technical ownership, cross-team impact, mentoring others).

End-state I want from this 1:1:
- Critical blocker resolved or clear rollback/hotfix plan with owners and dates.
- Cedric has a 2-sprint path to take one small cross-service rollout.
- A short KV-cache note exists that reduces future onboarding friction.

Rapid checklist for after meeting (tick boxes):
- [ ] Post summary to Slack
- [ ] Create RDW tickets for actions
- [ ] Add pairing invite to Cedric calendar
- [ ] Update Confluence with KV-cache doc link
- [ ] Set reminders for due dates

Misc / thoughts:
- Keep this page minimal and portable — paste into Slack or the 1:1 calendar invite as the agenda.
- If Cedric is overloaded, move the onboarding doc to a follow-up and prioritize the hotfix + tests first.

---
Version notes: initial draft 2026-04-04; cleanup and added exact action dates 2026-04-06.
